title: Payroll
overviewDescription: Review persisted payroll results for the active administration.
runsDescription: Process the payroll month by employee and review saved payroll runs.
runWorkspaceLoadFailed: Payroll run data could not be loaded. Try again.
runWorkspaceAccessDenied: You are not authorized to view payroll runs for this administration.
runWorkspaceDescription: Choose an existing pay period and select employees from the active administration.
noPeriods: No pay period is available for this administration yet.
openPeriodDescription: Choose a month. An existing draft period will be opened; a missing period will be created and opened.
openPeriodInvalid: Choose a valid monthly pay period.
openPeriodClosed: This pay period is closed and cannot be reopened.
openPeriodAccessDenied: You are not authorized to open a pay period for this administration.
openPeriodFailed: The pay period could not be opened. Check the period and try again.
periodNotOpen: This period is not open for payroll processing. Ask an authorized administrator to review the period.
periodSummaryDescription: Counts, amounts and exceptions from the saved run data for this month.
calculationException: The calculation failed; review the details.
staleException: The saved calculation differs from the current source data.
correctionSuccessor: The finalized run remains immutable; create a correction run.
recalculation_calculated: The employee was recalculated and saved as a concept.
recalculation_incomplete: The employee was calculated but remains blocked by incomplete components.
recalculation_sourceGap: The employee cannot be calculated: source data is missing.
recalculation_unsupported: The employee cannot be calculated: this situation is not supported.
recalculation_correctionRequired: The finalized run is immutable. A correction run is required.
recalculation_inProgress: The calculation is already in progress.
recalculation_accessDenied: You are not authorized to calculate this employee.
recalculation_invalid: The employee or period could not be safely identified.
recalculation_failed: The employee could not be calculated. Review the data.
noEmployeesForPeriod: There are no confirmed employments for this period.
rosterTooLarge: The employee list is larger than can safely be processed at once. Refine the selection or contact support.
conceptRunHint: Calculations are saved as concepts. Incomplete amounts are not processed as final net pay.
incompleteNetNotice: An amount after wage tax is not net pay. Employer costs and final net pay appear only when all applicable components are calculated.
missingSalary: A fixed monthly wage is missing or does not cover the full period.
unsupported_missingSalary: This pay type is not supported for this calculation.
missingSchedule: Scheduled hours or the part-time factor are missing or do not reconcile.
unsupported_missingSchedule: This schedule is not supported for this calculation.
missingContract: A confirmed contract covering the full period is missing.
unsupported_missingContract: There are multiple contract changes in this period.
missingLaborConditions: Confirmed employment terms covering the full period are missing.
unsupported_missingLaborConditions: There are multiple employment-terms changes in this period.
missingIncomeRelationship: A valid, active income relationship is missing.
unsupported_missingIncomeRelationship: The income relationship is ambiguous or not suitable for this calculation.
missingTaxProfile: An authorized HR administrator must confirm the tax declaration for this income relationship.
unsupported_missingTaxProfile: The tax declaration does not match the income relationship or period.
missingActualWork: Variable hours or other additional pay must be reviewed first.
unsupported_missingActualWork: These variable hours are not yet supported for payroll processing.
missingSupportedRules: No supported rule set is available for this period.
unsupported_missingSupportedRules: This rule set is not supported for this period.
unsupportedOtherData: This situation is not yet supported.
missingEmployeePension: The employee pension deduction is not fully calculated yet.
missingEmployerPension: The employer pension contribution is not fully calculated yet.
missingEmployerCosts: Employer premiums and other employer costs are missing.
missingReserves: Holiday and year-end reserves are missing.
missingCumulativeTax: The cumulative wage and tax basis is missing.
missingVariableWage: Variable and non-regular pay has not been processed.
batch_tooManySelected: Select no more than fifty employees per calculation.
batch_periodUnavailable: This pay period is unavailable or is not open for processing.
batch_scopeChanged: The employee selection has changed. Refresh the list and review the selection again.
batch_sourceNotReady: The selected employees have missing or unsupported information. No payroll calculation was started.
batch_accessDenied: You are not authorized to start payroll calculations for this administration.
batch_failed: The payroll calculation could not be started. Review the period and try again.
batch_success: The calculations have run. Review the remaining items for each employee.
batch_partial: Calculations started for employees with complete source information. Review what is still missing for each employee.
persistedOnly: Results shown here come from saved calculation runs.
empty: No payroll runs are available for this administration.
runHashesHint: Calculation values and hashes are shown in the run reconciliation.
transitionReviewed: The run has been reviewed and is ready for finalization.
transitionIncomplete: The run did not pass all controls and cannot proceed.
transitionSourceChanged: The source data changed. Recalculate the run before proceeding.
transitionAccessDenied: You are not authorized to process this run.
transitionInvalid: This lifecycle transition is not valid for the run.
transitionFailed: The run could not be processed. Check the data and try again.
netAfterTaxIncomplete: After wage tax (not final net pay)
finalized: Finalized result. Artifacts are bound to this run.
notFinalized: This run has no finalized lifecycle event.
storedPayslipPdf: Payslip PDF is stored for this finalized run.
payslipPdfUnavailable: The payslip PDF could not be stored.
persistedPayslipAvailable: The payslip PDF is saved and read back for this run.
persistedPayslipGenerationFailed: The payslip PDF could not be saved.
persistedPayslipReadbackFailed: PDF generation ran, but the persisted payslip could not be read back.
correctionsDescription: Review multiple persisted input versions for the same employee and period.
noCorrections: No runs with a changed source snapshot were found in the current history window.
compareDescription: Compare a persisted LiquidHR result with manually entered values from another payroll system.
externalComparisonReadOnly: External values are held in this browser view and cannot change the saved payroll result.
manualComparisonHint: Enter non-negative amounts using a decimal point or comma. Blank values are not compared.
arrangementsDescription: View payroll arrangements and component definitions.
arrangementCatalogDescription: Open the scoped arrangement catalog and its effective versions.
componentCatalogDescription: Inspect persisted component definitions and their package provenance.
settingsDescription: View payroll processing, recorded pay periods and the calendar structure for the active administration.
settingsScopeNotice: Settings are resolved from the signed-in administration context.
employerSetupDescription: Record employer classifications, sourced rates, reserves and the pension partial-period method for the active administration.
employerSetupSaved: The employer configuration was saved as a new immutable version.
employerSetupSaveFailed: The configuration could not be saved. Check the values and effective period.
employerSetupReady: All required employer settings are present for activation.
writePermissionRequired: You do not have write access to this employer configuration.
employerRatesDescription: Enter only percentages from the valid decision or official source. Blank values block activation.
pensionMethodDescription: Choose only a method supported by the pension scheme. The fiscal day or week factor is not automatically used as a pension factor.
componentSetNotCalculated: Determined by the standard NL-2026 component set.
configurationHistoryDescription: Every saved version remains auditable and is never overwritten.
configurationHistoryEmpty: No employer configuration has been recorded yet.
employerSetupBlocker_SOURCE_REFERENCE_RE: A source or decision reference is required.
employerSetupBlocker_HOLIDAY_ALLOWANCE_R: The holiday allowance rate is missing.
employerSetupBlocker_YEAR_END_APPLICABIL: Record whether a year-end allowance applies.
employerSetupBlocker_YEAR_END_RATE_REQUI: The year-end allowance rate is missing.
employerSetupBlocker_COMPONENT_SET_REQUI: The standard component set is not fully identified.
employerSetupBlocker_PENSION_PARTIAL_MON: The pension partial-period method is missing.
employerSetupBlocker_PENSION_METHOD_SOUR: The pension partial-period source is missing.
openingBalanceDescription: Record a sourced opening balance when the administration starts during the calendar year. This does not create historical payroll runs.
openingBalanceSaved: The opening cumulatives were saved as a new immutable version.
openingBalanceSaveFailed: The opening cumulatives could not be saved. Check the source, period and amounts.
openingBalanceNoEmployees: No confirmed employments are available in this administration.
openingBalanceMeaningDescription: Enter cumulative amounts before the opening date. Use only amounts from a traceable payroll source; values are euros with cent precision.
openingBalanceNoSyntheticValues: Do not estimate or enter zeros: missing source values block saving.
openingBalanceHistoryDescription: Versions are auditable, hashed and never overwritten. A new version supersedes the previous one through the highest version selected by the source.
openingBalanceHistoryEmpty: No opening balance has been recorded yet.
openingBalanceBlocker_OPENING_SOURCE_EMP: Select a valid employment from this administration.
openingBalanceBlocker_OPENING_PERIOD_AFT: The source period must end before the opening date.
openingBalanceBlocker_OPENING_SOURCE_REF: An opening-balance source reference is required.
openingBalanceBlocker_OPENING_VALUE_REQU: A cumulative source value is missing.
openingBalanceBlocker_OPENING_VALUE_INVA: A cumulative source value is invalid.
openingBalanceBlocker_OPENING_EXISTING_P: A payroll run already exists before the opening date; reconcile it to prevent double counting.
calendarDescription: Review recorded pay periods and check the structure for a calendar year.
calendarConfigNotRecorded: No calendar setting has been recorded for this administration yet.
calendarNoSavedPeriods: No pay periods have been recorded for this administration yet.
calendarPlanDescription: Set the frequency, period boundaries and any planned payment or processing dates.
calendarNotPersisted: You can prepare and review a calendar here. A new calendar is not saved or activated; the management action to record it is not available yet.
calendarMonthlyCalculationScope: The monthly structure is intended for supported fixed monthly wages. Tax sources and other payroll components are checked for each employment.
calendarFrequencyNotValidated: This frequency has not yet been validated for Dutch tax payroll calculations.
calendarError_CALENDAR_YEAR_INVALID: Choose a valid calendar year between 2000 and 2200.
calendarError_CALENDAR_VERSION_INVALID: The calendar setting has no valid version.
calendarError_CALENDAR_ANCHOR_REQUIRED: Enter a period start date for this frequency.
calendarError_CALENDAR_YEAR_ASSIGNMENT_R: Choose how a period around year-end is assigned to a calendar year.
calendarError_CALENDAR_DATE_RULE_INVALID: Check the selected payment date or processing deadline.
calendarError_CALENDAR_EFFECTIVE_RANGE_I: The calendar structure does not cover the selected calendar year.
calendarError_CALENDAR_PERIODS_OVERLAP: The pay periods overlap. Adjust the start date or frequency.
calendarError_CALENDAR_EFFECTIVE_RANGE_O: The effective period overlaps with another calendar setting.
calendarError_CALENDAR_REVISION_IDENTITY: This calendar setting cannot be changed in that way.
calendarError_CALENDAR_VERSION_INCREMENT: A change requires a new calendar version.
calendarErrorFallback: Check the calendar details and try again.
mySalaryDescription: Review your finalized salary amounts, monthly comparisons and available payslips.
noFinalizedSalary: No finalized salary statement is available yet.
pensionExplanationText: The amounts below come from the saved calculation for this period. A missing amount is not treated as zero.
salaryPensionTestAssumptions: Pension and net pay were calculated using the registered pension arrangement. The external fund terms have not yet been verified.
selfServicePrivacy: This view shows only your own finalized payroll amounts.
cumulative_wage_tax: Wage tax withheld year to date
noPersistedInputs: No separate input values were saved for this step.
noComponentTrace: No separate engine step was saved; the component result and version above come from the persisted calculation.
formulaNotRecorded: No separate formula text was saved for this step.
formulaGrossWage: Contractual salary plus the persisted variable wage components.
formulaTaxableWage: The separately persisted wage-tax assessment base.
formulaWageTaxTable: Lookup in the persisted wage tax table using the displayed table and period inputs.
formulaEmployerInsurance: Sum of the separately persisted AWf, Aof, Whk, Wko and Zvw contributions.
formulaNetPay: Taxable wage less wage tax and any applicable other deductions.
formulaReserve: Persisted reserve rate applied to the displayed wage base.
formulaCumulative: Opening balance plus the reserve accrued in this period.
formulaTotalEmployerCost: Gross pay plus employer contributions, employer pension, reserves and other employer costs.
assessmentBaseTimesRate: Assessment base × percentage ÷ 100; the saved result and rounding are shown in the engine trace.
employeeReconciliationFormula: Contractual salary and variable payments make up gross pay. Pension and other pre-tax deductions feed the applicable fiscal assessment bases; wage tax and any post-tax deductions lead to net pay. The separate persisted amounts are shown below.
employerReconciliationFormula: Gross pay + employer insurance contributions + employer pension + holiday reserve + year-end reserve + other employer costs = total employer cost.
notCalculated: Not calculated — source information could not be verified
conceptStatus: Concept — the run succeeded but is not finalized. It is not a finalized payslip.
pensionReadinessWarning: The pension calculation is saved, but the source check needs review. Finalization stays blocked until this is resolved.
pensionSourceVerificationRequired: Pension has not been calculated because the required source information could not be confirmed.
netNotDefinitive: Net pay is not final because the pension amount has not been confirmed.
PAYRUN01-CTRL-009-PENSION-RULE-READY: Pension arrangement configured; external fund contract not yet verified
grossToNetIntro: Gross pay is the starting point. Employee pension and applicable pre-tax deductions feed the separate assessment bases; wage tax and any other deductions lead to net pay. All amounts shown come from your finalized salary calculation.
essPensionSourceGap: Pension was not calculated; source verification is required.
essPensionReview: Your pension contribution is saved, but the source check needs review.
salaryHistoryEmpty: No finalized salary periods are available yet.
salaryChartDescription: The chart includes only available finalized pay periods.
salaryNoPreviousPeriod: There is no earlier finalized salary period to compare.
salaryNoComponentChanges: There are no comparable components with an amount change.
salaryTaxExplanation: Wage tax and the saved fiscal assessment bases come from the finalized calculation. A missing base does not mean zero.
salaryPensionExplanation: These amounts are the saved employee and employer contributions for this pay period. A missing amount does not mean zero.
salaryAllowanceExplanation: This section includes only allowances and additional payments saved for this finalized period.
salaryReserveExplanation: Reserves are the amounts saved for this period. They are not automatically part of net pay.
salaryPensionSourceGap: Pension has not been calculated because the required arrangement information could not be verified.
salaryPensionReview: The pension contribution was saved, but its source information needs review.
salaryChangeNotComparable: No percentage when the previous value is zero
localAcceptanceDescription: Controlled, complete calculations for synthetic Mars BV employments, October 2026.
localAcceptanceRestricted: Available only on this local development server
localAcceptanceAssumptionsDetail: Pension parameters, employer classifications and January–September opening balances are versioned synthetic TEST inputs. DEMO-003 uses its HR Admin confirmed fiscal profile for October. The pension arrangement is not a confirmed fund contract; the Whk rate is not a real employer decision. Original historical runs remain unchanged.
localAcceptanceAssumptionsSummary: 2026 white monthly table; payroll tax credit from the fiscal profile; pension, employer costs and net travel reimbursement.
localAcceptanceOpenFailed: The period could not be opened.
localAcceptanceAccessDenied: The signed-in user does not have write access for this administration.
localAcceptanceUnavailable: This function is available only on the configured local development server.
localAcceptanceFailed: The check could not be completed. No result has been confirmed.
localAcceptanceDemo003Saved: DEMO-003 was fully calculated, saved and independently checked. Open the run to review and finalize it.
localAcceptanceVariableRevisionHelp: Run this test after the regular DEMO-001 calculation has been reviewed and finalized. It requires a FINALIZED predecessor.
localAcceptanceVariableRevisionSaved: The separate DEMO-001 revision with €500 variable pay was calculated, stored, and independently checked. Open the run to review and finalize it if required.
localAcceptancePreflightBlocked: The source check did not fully pass. No calculations were started.
localAcceptanceSaved: Two complete concept calculations were saved and read back.
localAcceptancePartial: Some calculations were saved. Check which save or repeat-calculation check was not confirmed.
localAcceptanceCorrectionRequired: A controlled successor revision is required
localAcceptanceTestNature: TEST result: pension and employer rates are synthetic assumptions, not external contract or decision data.
localAcceptanceIdempotent: Repeat calculation with the same input
localAcceptanceIdempotentYes: Confirmed: same run, source, input and result
localAcceptanceMissingEmployeePension: Employee pension deduction is not fully calculated.
localAcceptanceMissingEmployerPension: Employer pension contribution is not fully calculated.
localAcceptanceMissingEmployerCosts: Employer premiums and other employer costs are missing.
localAcceptanceMissingReserves: Holiday and year-end reserves are missing.
localAcceptanceMissingCumulativeTax: Cumulative wages and tax base are missing.
localAcceptanceMissingVariableWage: Variable and non-regular pay has not been processed.
localAcceptanceOracleMatches: Wage tax matches the checked 2026 monthly table.
localAcceptanceOracleMismatch: Wage tax differs from the checked 2026 monthly table; the result is not confirmed.
localAcceptanceSalaryMismatch: The fixed pay does not reconcile to the part-time factor.
localAcceptanceUnknownGap: The source data could not be fully checked.
